availableBalance.settingHint: Turn this off for money you keep aside, like an emergency fund. The account still counts in total balance, net worth and reports.

proposal.title: Available balance setting
proposal.leaveOut: Leave {{name}} out of the available balance. It still counts in total balance, net worth and reports.

budgetForecast.toggleHelp: Adds what is left of each monthly budget as expected spending, spread evenly per day (this month from tomorrow). Budgets have no account: with an account or collection filter the amount is shown apart and not subtracted. Cannot be combined with Include estimate yet.
budgetForecast.introSubtracted: What is left of each monthly budget (budget minus posted minus scheduled, never below zero) is counted as spending and subtracted from the projected balance.
budgetForecast.introUnallocated: Budgets have no account, so with an account or collection filter this amount is shown apart and not subtracted from the balance.
budgetForecast.spread: Spread evenly per day from {{from}} to {{to}}
budgetForecast.noDaysLeft: No days left this month: not projected
budgetForecast.empty: No budgets in this period. Set budgets on the Budgets page to include them here.

recurringTransfers.amountReceivedHint: The accounts use different currencies: this is what arrives in {{name}} each time.

proposal.convert: {{count}} scheduled transfers of {{amount}} from {{from}} to {{to}} ({{description}}, {{frequency}}) become one recurring transfer.
proposal.convertOpen: It keeps going after the last one.

empty.inactive: No paused or ended recurring transactions.

overdue.title_one: {{count}} overdue occurrence (dated today or earlier, not recorded yet; it counts nowhere until recorded)
overdue.title_other: {{count}} overdue occurrences (dated today or earlier, not recorded yet; they count nowhere until recorded)

occurrences.title: {{description}}: occurrences
occurrences.help: Edit records that one occurrence now as a transaction with its own amount and date; the series does not change.

record.help: It is recorded now as a transaction with these values; the series keeps its own.

link.title: Link a transaction to the {{date}} occurrence
link.help: Transactions on the same account and of the same kind, within 20 days, not linked to another recurring transaction.

changeFrom.title: Apply the change from when?
changeFrom.fromHelpAmount: Earlier occurrences keep {{amount}}. The series shows both amounts.
changeFrom.wholeHelp: For fixing a mistake: the schedule itself changes.
changeFrom.wholeUnchanged: Transactions already recorded stay as they are.
changeFrom.impactTitle: What happens to transactions already recorded
changeFrom.follow_one: {{count}} scheduled transaction ({{dates}}) changes to the new values.
changeFrom.follow_other: {{count}} scheduled transactions ({{dates}}) change to the new values.
changeFrom.removed_one: {{count}} scheduled transaction ({{dates}}) is deleted: the new dates replace it.
changeFrom.removed_other: {{count}} scheduled transactions ({{dates}}) are deleted: the new dates replace them.
changeFrom.edited_one: {{count}} occurrence you edited on its own ({{items}}) keeps its values.
changeFrom.edited_other: {{count}} occurrences you edited on their own ({{items}}) keep their values.
changeFrom.skippedDropped: Skips that no longer fall on an occurrence are dropped: {{dates}}.
changeFrom.history: Posted history before today does not change.

end.title: End "{{description}}"?
end.body: Last occurrence on {{date}}. No occurrence after it is recorded or forecast. The schedule moves to Inactive.
end.deleteScheduled_one: Also delete the {{count}} scheduled transaction after that date ({{items}})
end.deleteScheduled_other: Also delete the {{count}} scheduled transactions after that date ({{items}})

trash.title: Delete "{{description}}"?
trash.body_one: It moves to Deleted: no longer recorded, forecast or matched to bank rows. You can restore it from Deleted. Its {{count}} recorded transaction stays as it is.
trash.body_other: It moves to Deleted: no longer recorded, forecast or matched to bank rows. You can restore it from Deleted. Its {{count}} recorded transactions stay as they are.
trash.deleteScheduled_one: Also delete the {{count}} scheduled transaction after today ({{items}})
trash.deleteScheduled_other: Also delete the {{count}} scheduled transactions after today ({{items}})

purge.title: Delete "{{description}}" permanently?
purge.body_one: The schedule, its skips and its edited occurrences are erased. Its {{count}} recorded transaction stays in your history without the recurring link. This cannot be undone.
purge.body_other: The schedule, its skips and its edited occurrences are erased. Its {{count}} recorded transactions stay in your history without the recurring link. This cannot be undone.

restore.title: Restore "{{description}}"?
restore.skipped_one: The {{count}} occurrence between then and today ({{dates}}) is marked as skipped.
restore.skipped_other: The {{count}} occurrences between then and today ({{dates}}) are marked as skipped.
restore.inactive: It comes back paused, as it was.

proposal.link_occurrence: Link a transaction to an occurrence
proposal.change_recurring_from: Change a recurring transaction from a date
